categories.main_business_segments: Tokyo Seimitsu operates two main business segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment and Metrology (Measuring Instruments). The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment provides wafer probing machines, dicing machines, and related processing and inspection equipment for semiconductor production. The Metrology segment offers precision measuring instruments such as coordinate measuring machines and surface roughness/profile measuring machines for manufacturing industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision measurement and precision machining technologies. Its core production methods include high-precision mechanical and electronic engineering, automation, and software integration for both semiconductor equipment and metrology products. Continuous R&D focuses on enhancing accuracy, throughput, and automation, as well as developing environmentally conscious and compact designs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor device manufacturers, OSATs (outsourced semiconductor assembly and test companies), electronics component makers, and manufacturers in automotive, machinery, aerospace, and battery industries. The end markets are primarily semiconductor fabrication and advanced manufacturing sectors requiring high-precision measurement and processing.
categories.geographic_coverage: Tokyo Seimitsu has a global footprint, with major operations in Japan, East Asia (notably China, Taiwan, and Korea), Southeast Asia (including Thailand and Malaysia), North America, and Europe. Overseas sales account for more than half of total revenue, and the company maintains production and sales subsidiaries in key regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream and downstream in the supply chain, supplying critical manufacturing equipment and precision measurement solutions to semiconductor fabs and manufacturing plants. It is a direct supplier to end-user manufacturers and also provides after-sales service and support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing world-leading products through continuous innovation, responding to advanced customer needs, and expanding into growth areas such as EVs, batteries, and automation. R&D themes emphasize high-precision, high-throughput, automation, digital transformation (DX), environmental sustainability, and synergy between semiconductor and metrology technologies. The company is also focused on strengthening its global production and sales capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of capital equipment (semiconductor manufacturing equipment and metrology instruments), as well as related consumables, software, and after-sales services such as maintenance and support. There is also a growing emphasis on recurring business models, including service contracts and evaluation services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global semiconductor equipment manufacturers (such as Tokyo Electron, Advantest, and DISCO) and precision metrology companies (like Mitutoyo and Zeiss). Tokyo Seimitsu positions itself as a global leader in both semiconductor back-end equipment and precision metrology, emphasizing its technological edge and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached 150.5 billion yen (up 11.8% YoY), with operating profit of 29.7 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 25.6 billion yen (up 32.3% YoY). The company has shown strong growth in both segments, with record-high sales and profits, and maintains a robust balance sheet with a high equity ratio (73.2%). The medium-term plan targets 185 billion yen in sales and 45 billion yen in operating profit by FY2028.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tokyo Seimitsu differentiates itself through its advanced precision technologies, high product reliability, and ability to deliver world-class, high-performance equipment tailored to customer needs. The company emphasizes its integrated solutions, global support network, and commitment to sustainability and productivity improvement for customers. Its unique value lies in combining semiconductor and metrology expertise to drive innovation in manufacturing.
